listing.name: Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers / omegakatana92
listing.summary: Native PC port of Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers (Capcom 1993, CPS-2), built with tmcleroy's cps2recomp by static recompilation. No emulator; the player brings their own ROM set. Free play, cheats and training aids. No game data included - bring your own ROM set. GPL-3.0. Not affiliated with Capcom.
